reviews.title: Poor customer service regarding lost baggage.
reviews.text: An otherwise great trip was let down by two baggage handling errors (one each way on a return journey). That's right, my baggage was misplaced on both legs. Although this is becoming common place in flights the communication to get my bag back was appalling. On the first journey the staff were dismissive and would not allow me to contact the baggage courier, nor did they make me feel that my concerns were listened to and that my new contact number had been given to the courier to contact me about appropriate delivery times (I never was contacted). This resulted in less sight seeing as I had to wait around to take delivery of the bag. The bag did turn up 60 hours later. The second flight was worse, but to be fair it was soon after mass flight cancellations (due to weather) so the system was in chaos (and occurred over public holidays). And all though the airline successfully put me on a train to replace the journey they refused to give me my bag, although it was confirmed as being onsite, instead opting to send it to a city once I registered the 'lost' bag online. I eventually got my bag (60 hours later) after many calls, multiple unsuccessful attempts at registering online and then to be told I had to return to an international airport to lodge the lost bag in person. Although the bag was returned to me sooner than I expected by a clever and thoughtful staff member (before I ever was able to register it successfully as lost). The stress caused results in the low review score.
reviews.author: algreary

reviews.title: Lost Luggage
reviews.text: Pilot advised the airport was struggling and did not have enough staff to load the plane. Promised it would be on the next flight to Budapest. 8 days later I still haven't seen my luggage. Disgusting airline. will never fly them again
reviews.author: Pikake

reviews.title: Worse customer service I have ever experiences in my life
reviews.text: Flights were cancelled out of Munich due to weather. Fair enough, not the airlines fault but their handling of it was abysmal. Kept saying they were rebooking flights then re cancelling them. Again I had some sympathy but the communication about what was going on was non existent. Finally managed to sort ourselves out by driving 400km to another airport and booking our own flights. We had no luggage as they had told us to check it in for the cancelled flight. Couldn’t report 5he missing luggage online as the system refused to accept the report saying I had to contact their so called Service Center. The Service Center said they could do nothing without an online report which was not possible. They suggested contacting the Baggage Claim department which I did. They said file a report online and I told them the system was not allowing it. They said they would file a report at their end and send me the reference number. They never did and when I called back the next day to check they had no record of my first call and said they couldn’t file a report for me. They said contacting the Service Center was the only option available which put me back in the never ending loop again. At one point they even told me I had to physically go to the Service Center in Munich even though I was in the Uk!? In short no one in any department in Lufthansa can do anything about anything and don’t seem to care. They are rude and totally unhelpful. Will never ever fly with them again and will be advisi
reviews.author: Michael J

reviews.title: Aircraft changed and seats reassigned without legroom
reviews.text: Lufthansa advised the aircraft was changed and we had seats beside each other (aisle and middle) though NOT with the paid for extra legroom seats. We weren't the only ones inconvenienced and for a 10+ hour flight we found it unacceptable. Our expectation is to have at least 50% of what our extra legroom cost was ($350.00 CDN refunded in cash, NOT a flight voucher or credit). Food was terrible and lacking as vegetarian option only available for the majority of passengers. Lufthansa's complaint emails not functioning which is ridiculous. I've tried three different computers to connect with Lufthansa and neither of the two emails work.
reviews.author: Robert S

reviews.title: 100% Consistent - Late
reviews.text: Wow, I haven’t the energy to detail the long list of issues with Lufthansa’s very poor service on our journey, but to summarise. 4 flights - DUB to FRA, FRA to BUD, BUD to FRA & FRA to DUB - All flights late ranging from an hour to two hours. Ground crew on the check in desks would be better suited to be working in the prison service shouting orders in a very rude, arrogant and threatening manner. Became hard to listen anything they said by the end of it. On a plus note the cabin crew were very professional, polite and very helpful too. I was extremely shocked how poor flying with Lufthansa is, makes flying with Ryanair look like a private jet service. It so nice to be home and not being spoken to like a piece of dirt anymore by Lufthansa staff.
reviews.author: Nck C

reviews.title: Run away from Lufthansa!
reviews.text: We are very unhappy past Lufthansa customers, and after almost 13 months of unsuccessful message exchanges and communications with the various Customer Service departments including asking for help from the US DOT - Do yourself a favor don't even consider Lufthansa, it's a black hole! We flew with Lufthansa on June 3d, 2022 from O'Hare to the Tel Aviv with a few hours stop in Frankfurt, Germany. Three of our checked bags were lost for over 9 days forcing us to buy few items, the cost of which are officially covered by the standard Airlines policies for the lost luggage. We provided Lufthansa with all the necessary information several times, but the company's Service Departments and mangers are totally ignoring our plea. On Jan 19, 2023, we received the last communication from the Lufthansa Customer Service asking for our bank information without providing any identifying information and/or the payment arrangement details and again, when we responded asking for clarifications, nobody replied. Today July 2023 - We did not receive a penny!
reviews.author: Ela M

reviews.title: Worth customer service
reviews.text: WORTH CUSTOMERS SERVICE! Lufthansa canceled a connection flight along WITH MY DAUGHTER’s TICKET!? Fully confirmed, with $800 seats upgrade. Their solution - buy new tickets. last time with Lufthansa. Stay away
reviews.author: FunTravel4All

reviews.title: Rediculous leg space and misleading information
reviews.text: Like the title says, the leg space is rediculous and they don't actually let you select a seat even though they advertise "Economy" as a plan where this is possible. I'd avoid flying with Lufthansa whenever possible.
reviews.author: Jen

reviews.title: Cancelation and leaving for 24 hours without any accommodation in airport
reviews.text: I recently had the unfortunate experience of flying with Lufthansa from Vancouver to Frankfurt, and I must say it was an absolute nightmare. From start to finish, the airline demonstrated a complete lack of professionalism and disregard for their customers. I encountered numerous issues that left me thoroughly disappointed and frustrated. To begin with, the flight schedule was changed not once or twice, but a staggering six times. It was incredibly inconvenient and disrupted my entire travel plans. Eventually, the flight was canceled, citing what I believe was a flimsy excuse of excessive snowfall. While the snowfall may have been considered significant by Lufthansa's standards, it was nothing out of the ordinary for the region. Their lack of preparation and adaptability was highly disappointing. Furthermore, the customer service provided by Lufthansa was abysmal. There was a complete absence of apologies or attempts to rectify the situation. Instead of promptly notifying passengers of the changes or offering alternative solutions, they displayed a shocking level of incompetence. They seemed completely unaware of proper customer service protocols, such as arranging taxis or providing accommodations for stranded passengers. This lack of knowledge and disregard for passengers' well-being was both disheartening and frustrating. In addition, the airline failed to meet even the basic needs of their customers. They did not provide appropriate food options for passengers, leaving ma
reviews.author: Reza

reviews.title: Awful customer service from a horrible airline
reviews.text: Shady, dishonest customer service. Anyone who flies regularly knows bulkhead seats are generally less legroom than the regular seats. I even requested to be moved from first class on a U.S. flight to premium because the bulkhead killed the room I had to stretch my leg. Anyway, I paid an extra $125 for a seat I confirmed with customer service was "extra legroom." I asked multiple times to confirm this was a bulkhead seat with extra legroom and I was told yes, so I paid the extra amount. When I got on the plane, I come to find out that they lied to me, which I confirmed by stretching my legs in the non-bulkhead seat behind me. I requested a refund which I regularly followed up on, and trusted that they would look into. In hindsight I am an idiot for not contesting this with my credit card immediately. I got the run around for months with no resolve, saying they were working on it. At this point, with multiple follow up emails and calls, I don't even hear from them anymore. This airline is terrible with horrible customer service. Do not fly on this scummy airline if you don't want to be ripped off. If you have the option to fly another airline, please do. If something happens that requires a refund, they will pretend they are investigating, then stop responding to you once outside of the window you can contest the charge with your credit card company.
reviews.author: forsterm2018

reviews.title: Worst airline ever!
reviews.text: DO NOT FLY this airline! Spent a lot on business class to only be treated like trash. Canceled flights and zero compensation. Horrible customer service and just a complete let down. Save your money or buy another ticket from another airline. They suck!!
reviews.author: Kali

reviews.title: Left us stranded told us to find out own way home
reviews.text: we could not land to Munich on June 23 because of a thunderstorm. We were diverted to Milan after flying in a circle pattern for some time for refueling. After refueling, the Lufthansa crew decided they wanted to go home so they cancelled the flight and left 300 passengers stranded at the Milan airport. We all stood in line all night at the airport just to get a hotel. There were two people helping with this and one taxi driver. The Italian contractors who work for Lufthansa upstairs at the ticket counter were nasty. They would not help any of the passengers get rebooked with their tickets, the managers showed up at 6am, told us all in english that we were on our own, to buy our own tickets that he was not a magician. These were passengers from Germany, Sweden, United States. The agents were so Nasty, they brought 20-30 passengers ahead of us and told us that these passengers had priority and to go to the other line. I will never fly Lufthansa ever again. We ended up buying an additional one way ticket to the United States for $3200, Munich was not our final destination. A british man was going all the way to Bangkok, he couldn't even purchase a ticket because they were all ready overbooked. The value office was responsible for getting us a hotel, they put us in one an hour away. We almost missed our flight the next day because the transport didn't come early enough, we got the last two seats on the plane. Of course, we our disputing all charges with our bank. I am shocked at
reviews.author: marsha w

reviews.title: AWFUL!
reviews.text: I am a frequent traveler and will never fly Lufthansa again. From the disorganization of boarding, to the delayed flights, changing our return flight constantly during our trip to loosing our luggage upon our return. This was due to them changing our return flight and giving us mere minutes to make connection, which obviously wasn’t enough to time to transfer our bags. I’ve only flown them once before, but since then they seem to have forgotten how to do their jobs. From ticket agents, to flight attendants and ground crew (took 15 mins for them to bring stairs to on time flight) they were awful. Oh! And also had the worst landing of any flight I’ve ever been on with the pilot slamming the plane to the tarmac. I’m actually amazed by how every single thing about both our inbound and outbound flights sucked!
reviews.author: Fienneone

reviews.title: Worst Airline - 0 for customer support
reviews.text: Really bad experience interacting with customer support on 18001025838 . It took almost 50 calls to get connected with their customer support
reviews.author: mayank

reviews.title: Mrs
reviews.text: They cancelled my flight from Berlin to Frankfurt so I can fly to Tunis from there and forced me to take another flight to Munich to sleep over there and take the flight to Tunis the next day. They said that was “the best option” and don’t get me started on that Service Center they have in Munich. The waiting time is +1h in a queue. They charge you for +600€ for the trip, they cancel the flights and change your itinerary as they wish, and once you are on board, they don’t even offer good beverages and food during the flight, you have to pay for it. Definitely I won’t consider Lufthansa as my first option to travel from now on.
reviews.author: CH.M

reviews.title: Damaged or lost luggage every time
reviews.text: The staff on the actual plane is very nice. But the workers who handle the luggage don’t give a sh**. They don’t carefully handle the luggage as their job require, they throw it and break it. I’ve seen it with my own eyes once when they were handling bags as I was switching to a connection flight. I only travel to Europe once a year and every single time my luggage is either missing or broken. Horrible, horrible, horrible.
reviews.author: Dee

reviews.title: I will NEVER choose Lufthansa again
reviews.text: Absolutely disgraceful airline. Continuous delays causing me to miss my connecting flights on both the way out and the return journey home. How can an airline get it so wrong. NEVER again will I use this airline.
reviews.author: Jody S

reviews.title: 10 hours of agony
reviews.text: It was the worst flight ever. Old plane, no entertainment working - it looked as if it was there on that sad screen, but pressing on it didn't change anything. Staff sour, rude, not smiling once. Chairs were so extremely low quality that 2 days later I'm still sore everywhere. I know long flights on economy class are never easy. But Lufthansa took it to a way new level of agony. Shame on you all. I can't comprehend how services like this are still on business and staff like that are even legal to interact with customers.
reviews.author: Cristina N

reviews.title: Unfair Service upon check in - Bullied by non English speaking clerk
reviews.text: I am writing to express my formal complaint regarding the treatment I received during my return flight from Poznan airport with Luftansa. I found the conduct of your staff to be highly disappointing and unprofessional. I kindly request your attention to the following incident: Upon check-in, it was discovered that my bag exceeded the weight limit by 1 kilogram, totaling 24 kilograms. Consequently, I was informed by a particularly rude Luftansa staff member that I would be charged an amount of PLN 222.91. I was not given the opportunity to remove any items from my bag nor was I provided with the option to check my luggage through to my final destination in South Africa. Instead, I was bluntly instructed to make the payment. Interestingly, my colleague, who was traveling on the same flight, stood next to me with an overweight bag weighing 25.5 kilograms, yet he was not subjected to any charges. When I raised this inconsistency with the staff member assisting me, his response was dismissive, stating that it was solely at the discretion of his colleague to impose charges. He then insisted that I contact my fellow traveler and ask him to pay for his excess baggage. Which I did not do. To exacerbate matters, when I requested to speak with a manager to address the issue, no one was willing to assist me in English. As someone who would frequently traveling with Luftansa, as arranged by my company, I expected better treatment and a fair resolution to this matter. Instead, I felt bulli
reviews.author: Reta S

reviews.title: Very disappointed
reviews.text: All aboard -> immediately after "boarding completed" announcement: delay at least 1 hour 10 minutes -> no off-load back to business lounge and no service onboard. Thank You Lufthansa! Once again "Deutsche Hospitality"
reviews.author: Timo R

reviews.title: Value and efficiency
reviews.text: Timely and effective service, dealt with check in very effectively no security delays cheerful and helpful check in staff and crew. Food offering ok not restaurant standard but dispensed with cheer and filling. For short trip similar value to budget airline with a little bit more panache.
reviews.author: Joseph M

reviews.title: Horrible flight
reviews.text: I don't normally write flight reviews, but this time I just had to as it was the worst flight I've ever had. Flew on Monday Frankfurt to Singapore on a 747-800 - which is a great plane but we must have had the worst seats - absolute total lemons. Firstly I had asked for a window seat - yes got it, however when I sat down, there was no window, just a large blank wall. This on its own would be okay however both mine and my traveller's entertainment screens failed to work - the crew did try to fix it, but couldn't. Then our seats (20A and 20B) failed to recline. My seat had the box in front of me, but it also had something behind so the seat just would not budge. If it couldn't get any worse on a 13 hour flight, with nothing to look out the window as there was none, and nothing to watch on the screen, the breakfast served on such a long flight was a horrible smelly sandwhich, a muesli bar and a yoghurt - just disgusting. I couldn't eat it as it looked awful and smelt worse. I've always raved about Lufthansa in the past, but would be very reluctant to fly with them at the moment, they need to get their act together and stop using Covid issues as an excuse for poor service. In comparison, our next flight from Singapore to Auckland on Singapore Airlines was much different - everything worked and we had two hot meal services - even though the flight was shorter than with Lufthansa.
reviews.author: Amanda B

reviews.title: If you are you from Latin America, don't expect to get compensation from Lufthansa.
reviews.text: It's been almost a year since Lufthansa cancelled our Madrid-Frankfurt-San José (Costa Rica) flight on Premium Economy and sent the 4 of us via Avianca's Economy (terrible service) without a proper compensation of 2400 EUR as states the EU Law. They sent me a payment advice saying they allegedly "wired" the money, but the bank won't accept the transfer until they provide proper proof in the international format MT103, which includes the unique payment reference number UETR. So in summary, if you have a Latin American Bank such as BAC Credomatic which requests this format, you will never see your money as they don't know what a MT103 format is, which is unbelievable coming from such a prestigious airline as this format is widely used throughout the world, so they are probably just trying for me to give up and save the money. - Alejandro Chacon Chacon
reviews.author: Alejandro Chacón

reviews.title: Online check-in not working
reviews.text: Travelling with a group of eight we were surprised to be asked to input everyone's details for the return flight. Why were these not retained from the outbound flight?! Then having input it all we got a data collection error. Tried with mobile phone, laptop and tablet and both website and app. Very frustrating and anxiety inducing. Checking in at the airport meant we got rubbish seats at the rear of the plane. Flights outbound and inbound both delayed. Seats uncomfortable with minimal legroom.
reviews.author: Sharon C

reviews.title: Lufthansa is cheapening up, cutting all service at cost of customers
reviews.text: I think they used to be a high-end airline but now I hear from others many similar stories that they are saving money through cutting corners that hurt. I started my flight at 1855 from Stockholm and had to pay for food Sthlm-Germany, then Germany-Johannesburg I got a small dinner sometime after midnight, with a very tiny breakfast of sweetend yoghurt and bread with cheese and weird oily vegetable tapenade on top of the cheese (why serve something so "alternative?" - people didn't seem to like it). I was starving on arrival when a cheery message informed me that my bag was not in Jo-burg with me... The booking system had suggested a flight with only a 1hr stopover in Frankfurt which was probably not enough to reload the bags, alternativeley the plane was too full so they just offloaded random bags. But we were a good group of people from different connections who had their bags still in Europe when we arrived in Johannesburg. They seemed to be hoping we would all file reports on where to deliver the bags online instead of taking up time from a real person but as I was still flying an internal flight the system couldn't handle it. Imagine if they had thought to offload the bags of people who were homebound to Joburg how much easier it would have been to deliver them and how much less hassle it had been for the people who just came home... If you are going to meetings or holidays its obviously mush worse not to have your bags on arrival. I landed Sunday afternoon in my final de
reviews.author: Nontyatyambo

reviews.title: Beware of this airlines company, they are the WORST!
reviews.text: I swear if I could give them 0 stars I would, never in my life I’ve faced such a disappointment with every step in the way. We had a flight from Israel to Lisbon, with 1 stop in Frankfurt. Our flight got delayed, even though we had a connecting flight (also Lufthansa’s flight) and we had to spent the entire flight worrying if we will make it on time. We landed in almost two hours delay and ran like CRAZY at the airport just to get the next flight. They didn’t let us going to the plane with our trolly luggage, even though we explained them that we have a connecting flight right after and we have to run there, and that we really concerned that the luggage won’t come with us to the next flight. They reassured us that the luggage will be transfer with our next flight automatically. Guess what? IT DID NOT. Of course that this nightmare continues on to our luggage got lost and stayed at the connecting airport (Frankfurt). Just great. After all this horrible experience they lost our luggage??? Really? The next day they said that the luggage will be at the Lisbon airport at 11:15 AM. We only got a confirmation message at 15:00 PM. We came to the airport to pick it up and we had to wait in a 2 HOURS in the ground force boot just to get a clue where they placed our luggage. How about writing that in the e-mail? Need to reach Lufthansa’s service center? Wait for 45 MINUTES just to speak to a person in order to find out where to even go! Overall, the entire first day of our vacation was
reviews.author: MelanyBenjamin

reviews.title: Unable to check in online
reviews.text: With 22 hours to go we tried to check in online as advised. Unable to do so becuase we kept getting 'technical error - not specified' message. So tried the on line chat only to end up speaking to a useless BOT (AI that doesn't work). BOT tells me to call Lufthansa, it costs 40p/minute to do that! First time we have flown with Lufthansa and it will be the last if this is anything to go by!
reviews.author: David E

reviews.title: Worst airline
reviews.text: Always delayed, rude and terrible customer service. Unfortunately the government keeps subsidizing it so they don't have to even strive to be competitive.
reviews.author: Marina R

reviews.title: Lufthansa Hell Hole
reviews.text: My family and I had an absolutely horrific experience with Lufthansa this past month. This all occurred on May 20, 2023 concerning a flight from Charlotte, NC to Munich, Germany. My cousin's birthdate was incorrect on her boarding pass, so when she tried to go through security, she was sent back to the help desk to get it fixed. Her boyfriend was traveling with us as well, and he went with her to the help desk. The agent at the desk fixed her boarding pass, and then she decided to go ahead and check the boyfriend's boarding pass as well to ensure everything was fine for both of them. The agent found a discrepancy between the boyfriend's name on his passport versus the name on his booking. The name on the booking was "Kiah," which is what we all call him on a daily basis, but his government name is "Hezekiah," and that's what is in his passport. One might think that this is an easy fix. The agent can just go in and correct his name to match his passport just like they changed my cousin's birthdate to match her actual birthdate. WRONG! My cousin, her boyfriend, and my uncle fought with a plethora of agents at the Lufthansa help desk for HOURS trying to get this simple problem fixed. They were met with hatred, confusion, dismissal, and every other form of ignorant customer service you can imagine. Meanwhile, the 4 other people in our party (including myself) were already waiting at our gate ready to board. And mind you, we're trying to get on our first flight that will eventuall
reviews.author: Emily L

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: Boarding of flight was not great - Group 3 was allowed to board before Group 2 was done !!??!. Plane was crowded - but that's typical for any airline. Upon arrival at midnight in Oslo, bags took forever to come. But ours was not there - had not made the transfer at Frankfurt. Seems like the airline has grown to be a bit more than the team can effectively manage. Its a day later, and multiple flights have come to Oslo, and we still don't have our bags.
reviews.author: Bob S
